name: Ben Tuckwell

name: Thomas Rainka
caption: A Winnipeg-billed wrestler for the Lone Star Wrestling Union who survived a three-on-one handicap match before losing the Southwestern Championship battle royal.

tenures.note: A Canadian technician who said he made his name in Texas, the VWF's T3 Champion from November 2001. Lost Championship to Erik Andrews on 10 January, feuded with Zell Strife, and was pinned four-way Title match at Ghost Town Blues after setting Strife Tony Cage fire a lit chair. Appears across VWF documents, February June 2002.
